settings.heading: Start a Return
settings.lede: Tell us about an order you need reviewed.
settings.notice: The current storefront is a gated exhibition. Test orders do not need a parcel returned.

settings.heading: For an exhibition test order
settings.text: Use Contact Us and include the test order reference, the email used and what you want us to review. Please omit payment information. Do not ship anything to Maison Tavo.

settings.heading: If your order page offers returns
settings.text: Open the order status link in your confirmation email or Account. If a return action is available there, follow the steps shown for that order. Availability depends on the store settings and order status.

settings.label: Refund and Returns Policy
settings.text: Read the exhibition returns and refund information.
